description: Lightricks LTX Extend — seamlessly extend any existing video at the start or end, preserving motion, audio, and visual style.

input_video.description: Existing video URL to extend. Must be 16:9 or 9:16, at least 73 frames (~3s), max 4K.

prompt.description: Optional description of what should happen in the extended portion.

duration.description: Duration in seconds to extend. Minimum 2s, maximum 20s.

extend_direction.description: Where to extend the video: end (append) or start (prepend).
